page.layout: One printed page (right-hand page of the opening) with one column of text; running head at top; a catchword/signature line at the foot ("N 2" with "diatur" as catchword); fragmentary marginal text at the left edge belonging to the facing page, not transcribed.

main_text.p: quem ista suppeditat exercitatio: Dominam sermone detineas necesse est : disertum te faciet hæc Schola: Sed ecce quæ Rhetorica: Sacros de religione, Philosophicos de Natura, forenses de Republica, familiares de œconomia sermones, ab elegantiis proscripsit magister Amor : Tetricos hos vocat aut frivolos: inter Myoses ei & Battologias recensentur: Si aliquam ex his phrasim dictis tuis aspergis, ad manum ei vibratæ ferula facetiæ, & ni ocyus desistas, turpis scutica repulsæ: Sit geniale, festivum, & cum cæremoniis officiosum, quidquid huc adsertur ; Est tamen & in parte ista, quod evites: Si exquiras nimium, & è libello dicas, irridebere Pomphologus. Adde quod ad venustatem efflorescit animus, qui subinde reficitur arrisione, & benigno Dominæ radiatur
main_text.notes: Left margin carries fragmentary text of the facing page (not transcribed). The first line is partly obscured at the left by the gutter shadow; words read as printed. Catchword "diatur" and signature "N 2" at foot.
